note: NOT the instrument. This is the shape the marker programs read, written by A1 so that A1's code could be tested before A4's file exists. The instrument is A4's, at <rig>/instrument/criteria.json, and the markers take --criteria only to point at a different file; with no flag they read A4's path and stop if it is not there.  certified_candidate mirrors A4's real file: the read-outs and the gauges are false and carry no arm difference (fault 1 of the stage-A review), so `agreement.py --dry` exercises the certification filter end to end.

agreement.k_rule: k = the arm's (a)-to-(a) baseline on that field plus three (W10 section 5)
agreement.baseline_rule: the baseline for a field is the number of documents on which any two of the three repeats of arm (a) disagree; all three (a)-to-(a) pairs are taken, and a document counts as disagreeing when any pair disagrees (W3 section 5, P4.1)
agreement.uninformative_rule: a field whose baseline exceeds half the documents says nothing and is reported so (W3 P4.1)

fields.name: test_remove
fields.title: Remove
fields.criterion: RAN when the report takes a named part away and says what happens to a named job. NAME ONLY when the test is named and nothing is taken away. ABSENT when the test is not named. CANNOT when the report names the test, quotes the sentence of the document that leaves it nothing to reach, and leaves a part unknown.

fields.name: marks_per_part
fields.title: The eight marks, part by part
fields.criterion: for each numbered part of the report, the one mark the report gives it; read by document, never summed

fields.name: pairs_that_pull
fields.title: Pairs that pull, named
fields.criterion: the set of unordered pairs of part numbers the report names as pulling against each other; the empty set is a value

fields.name: same_explanation_verdict
fields.title: The same-explanation verdict
fields.criterion: PRESENT when the report says of two candidates that no change on the list tells them apart; the sentence is quoted; never counted (H64 struck the count)

fields.name: shape
fields.title: The report's shape
fields.criterion: <A4 rewords the PART boundary H64 struck>

fields.name: turned_own_test
fields.title: Turned its own test on itself

fields.name: question_identity
fields.title: The question the run froze
fields.criterion: SAME when the question the report freezes is the one handed in (same target, same range, same thing asked); MOVED otherwise, with both quoted

fields.name: modules_self_reported
fields.title: The modules the reader says it opened
fields.criterion: the set of reference files the report itself names as opened; kept apart from the transport's record (W8 part C4, P4.9)

fields.name: marks_outside_closed_list
fields.title: Marks outside the closed list (arm e)
fields.criterion: how many marks in the report are not one of the eight; arm (e) only

fields.name: attributions_moved
fields.title: Attributions moved under the name exchange (arm x)
fields.criterion: the set of claims the report attributes to a name, as name|claim-number; arm (x) and its arm (a) control only

fields.name: example_cross_step_field
fields.title: A cross-step field this example invents, so the dry run exercises the exclusion rule
fields.criterion: NOT A FIELD OF THE INSTRUMENT, and no marker will ever meet it. A1's stand-in, invented for the dry run (fault 31 of the fix round's review): the stand-in table gives this name the empty affordance list, so `python3 agreement.py --dry` still prints '[no arms document affords it]' and the exclusion rule is still exercised end to end, without the line naming a field A4's instrument reads. Value it never takes; it is marked on no report.

example.report: none: this field is marked on no report

fields.source: this example file, and nowhere else

fields.name: quotes
fields.title: The sentences the marker leaned on
fields.criterion: free text; never compared for agreement, kept so a disagreement can be traced

corpus_affordance.note: a stand-in for A4's table (W11 D4), so the dry run exercises the rule. The real table is instrument/affordance.json; this one names only fields of this example. The empty list stands against `example_cross_step_field`, which this example invents for the purpose (fault 31 of the fix round's review). Before that it stood against `turned_own_test`, a real field of A4's instrument that the corpus records NEITHER WAY and that the harness therefore READS (fault 28), so the documented dry run printed the opposite of the truth about it. In A4's real table the only empty `affords` list is `test_patches`, an exclusion the corpus does record, and `turned_own_test` is not named there at all.
